clipping_pct.description: percentage of samples at or above clipping_threshold per measurement

clipping_threshold.description: absolute normalized sample level counted as clipped

frame_seconds.description: analysis-frame duration used for speech and floor measurements

max_zero_fraction.description: frames at or above this exact-zero share are excluded from level measurements

measurement_count.description: number of entries in each metric array

measurement_seconds.description: seconds of audio each value describes

min_live_noise_frames.description: minimum live non-speech evidence required before SNR and noise floor are measurable

min_real_noise_floor_dbfs.description: levels at or below this converter floor count as digital silence

noise_floor_context_seconds.description: local context used to estimate the noise floor

noise_floor_dbfs.description: local noise floor in dBFS per measurement; null where no real room tone is measurable

sample_rate_hz.description: sample rate of the measured delivered audio

schema_version.description: version of this signal-metrics file shape

snr_db.description: signal-to-noise ratio in dB per measurement; null without measurable speech or room tone

speaker_index.description: which speaker stem (seat or scripted role)
